# Experiment-protocol template

Copy this structure for a specific experiment. Record the decisions before final evaluation. Clearly identify any exploratory changes made after examining results.

## Identity and question

Protocol identifier and version; author; status; research question; intended use; hypothesis or exploratory purpose; related decision or issue.

## Population and modules

Population and disease stage; selection criteria; model family and exact revision; parameters; module composition; compatibility assumptions; relevant upstream citations.

## Scenario and interventions

Initial conditions; warm-up and duration; time and units; meals and other events; observed information; control policy; treatment variants; randomization and seeds.

## Data and calibration

Data source and version; access and publication permissions; preprocessing; missingness; calibration method; development/evaluation separation; participant overlap; identifiability assumptions.

## Outcomes and analysis

Primary and secondary outcomes; metric definitions and versions; uncertainty analysis; comparisons; numerical tolerances and their justification; exclusions; failed and incomplete run handling.

## Reproduction

Software revisions; environment lockfile; commands; expected artifacts; run manifest; input and output checksums where appropriate; deterministic or tolerance-based comparison criteria.

## Interpretation and review

Permitted claim; limitations and extrapolation; comparison with a simpler reference; software and scientific review scope; independent reproduction status; conditions that would change the conclusion.

## Changes and corrections

Version history; deviations from the original analysis plan; reasons; affected results; links to correction notices and replacement artifacts.
